dimensions.detail: The declared purpose, commands, required API key, proxy URL, curl fallback, and npm CLI install all align with a web-fetch/search proxy skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are user-directed and scoped to fetch/search/screenshot/render/raw/nocache requests, but those requests necessarily send URLs, queries, and request details to the DeShell proxy.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation uses the external npm package @deshell/mcp; the README explicitly tells users to verify package provenance, but the package contents are not included in this artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: DESHELL_API_KEY and DESHELL_PROXY_URL are proportionate for the proxy use case; DESHELL_EXTRA_HEADERS is disclosed but users should avoid putting secrets or sensitive internal headers in it.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only Markdown skill files, no executable scripts, no background workers, no persistence, and no requests to modify other skills or local profiles.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The proxy privacy concern is real but purpose-aligned and partly disclosed by the skill name, description, proxy URL, API-key setup, and curl examples; it supports user guidance rather than Review because there is no hidden or automatic data transfer beyond requested proxy operations.
[SQP-2] expected: The SKILL.md commands can send arbitrary URLs, search queries, rendered pages, screenshots, raw fetches, and optional headers through DeShell; this is the core functionality, though the artifact should more plainly warn against sensitive URLs, private data, and secret headers.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with requested URLs, search terms, fetched content, and the DeShell API key being handled by the DeShell service. Verify the @deshell/mcp npm package before installing, prefer a scoped or disposable API key, and do not use DESHELL_EXTRA_HEADERS for secrets, internal auth headers, private-network URLs, regulated data, or confidential research unless you trust the proxy or self-host it.
llm.summary: This skill does what it says: it lets an agent fetch web pages and search through the DeShell proxy, with privacy and package-provenance caveats.
